prompt: Start a Mancala game on my phone and play pits 3, 1 and 5, then tell me the score. Do not use the Play Store, no installs, no sign-in.
notes: Same prompt, same phone, clean app state per side. Left: no skill, the agent drives the UI by hand. Right: find_skill + run_skill. 'ok' means the agent finished its turn; the result was not independently checked.
